question: Does winter apparent advantage of solar phase over pooled clock prediction survive when both candidates receive the same season label?
required_output: winter and summer season-specific solar-vs-season-specific clock
clock season-conditioning and solar season-conditioning increments
winter and summer specific season-conditioning advantage attributable to clock over solar
fixed original negative solar superiority decision
absence of pairwise adjusted-difference bootstrap interval in original first result
original site/bootstrap provenance and exploratory data limitations
hard_stops: Missing any of original three component score differences or nonfinite values
Any attempt to combine confidence interval endpoints from correlated contrasts
Any empirical p-value or bootstrap recomputation
Any upgrade of original both-seasons-positive hypothesis to supported
Any postoutcome selection of taxa, seasons, alternate sun-anchor or score scale
not_claimed: A significant advantage of conditioned clock because original matched covariance for adjusted contrast is unavailable
Causal daylength, photoperiod or behaviour mechanism
Equivalence of animal detections to actual animal activity
Original process-v5 or earlier empirical terminal route reclassification
A new stochastic refit success-probability endpoint
